objective: Find additional non-duplicate GOLD candidates by separating market mechanism, direction, timeframe context, confirmation, risk and payoff instead of repeatedly filtering one LONG lineage.

data.decision: closed bars only; higher timeframe bar_close_time <= decision_time
data.entry: exact M1 open at decision time with bid/ask handling

risk_profiles: 8 and 16 M15-bar structural swing with 0.10 ATR buffer, clipped to 0.50-1.50 ATR

selection_contract.freeze: top stable variants per mechanism and direction before later-period diagnostics
selection_contract.diagnostic: 2024, 2025 and 2026 fixed; no post-result threshold changes
selection_contract.neighborhood: adjacent parameter cells must remain positive
selection_contract.rolling_check: monthly causal selector using past resolved results only, reported separately from static candidates
